header.scope: Docs-only audit of current approval/risk enforcement surfaces against a future Rust Approval Authority. No runtime changes made.

surfaces.caller: no production caller (exercised only by broker tests in CP3)
surfaces.approval_check: schema-only: required_approval=true is rejected with ErrorCode::PlanRejectedApproval before any spawn; approval.plan_id must equal plan.plan_id and approval must be null unless required_approval=true
surfaces.replay_check: in-memory executed_plans HashSet (single-use guard), not durable across restart
surfaces.note: This is the only execution entry gate. CP7 must replace the blanket reject with a real Approval Authority consult: store lookup, token digest, actor authority, expiry, consume-before-spawn, and a durable ledger.

surfaces.approval_check: none independent; inherits the execute() gate. A direct caller would bypass approval entirely.
surfaces.note: Single spawn path today. CP7 must keep this path private and perform atomic grant-consume immediately before spawn (never after) inside the broker.
The only broker surface exposed over IPC is read-only status. It exposes no plan, approval, or execute mutation.

surfaces.approval_check: no approval or execute command is registered
surfaces.note: Command registry contains no executePlan, grantApproval, or generic execution command. Adding a WebView-reachable generic execute or approval mutation command would be BLOCKS_CP7.

surfaces.approval_check: binding registration carries no approval semantics
surfaces.note: Bindings are registered internally at startup. No external path can inject a binding.

surfaces.approval_check: all five production bindings are read-only (github.repo.inspect, github.issue.search, github.issue.read, github.pr.read, github.pr.checks.read)
surfaces.note: Production write bindings = 0. CP7 must keep this count at 0; any write binding added during CP7 is a fail-oracle violation.

surfaces.approval_check: schema-only. Structural validity is checked, but no store record, digest, or grant is consulted.
surfaces.note: Comment in code states the schema mirrors ApprovalReferenceSchema and CP3 never treats it as approval. CP7 must make the reference resolve to a durable, digested store record; schema-valid != approved.
The TS layer must never become approval-authoritative. CP7 keeps the Brain as a requester: it can carry a reference, only the native Authority can grant/validate it.

surfaces.approval_check: TS-side consistency only (awaiting_approval requires required_approval=true; contradictory approval states flagged)
surfaces.note: TS validation is advisory. Native re-validation of required_approval, risk snapshot, and approval reference must happen at the broker gate on every execute call.

surfaces.approval_check: explicitly NOT an approval token, NOT execution authority, NOT a plan-state transition
surfaces.note: CP6 eligibility produces coverage lineage only. CP7 must preserve this boundary: eligibility output cannot substitute for approval.

surfaces.approval_check: not applicable; trusted capability catalog, provider registry, and subject resolvers; caller can never choose providers or inject time
surfaces.note: CP6 request surface is strict (z.strictObject). No provider registration path exists for untrusted callers; CP7 must keep it that way.
Cancellation cannot grant or execute anything. Keep it unexposed over generic IPC.

surfaces.approval_check: no public endpoint that grants, revokes, or asserts approval was found
surfaces.note: Audit of approve/approval/grant/setApproval/markReady over REST, MCP, Tauri commands, mobile, and browser extension found nothing. Any generic public approval mutation API added in CP7 is BLOCKS_CP7.

surfaces.approval_check: none: a caller can construct a plan object carrying present/verified evidence ids and an approval-shaped reference without any real qualification
surfaces.note: Forged coverage snapshot / forged ApprovalReference threat. CP7 integration must answer: eligibility for executable state comes only from Guard-run output (signed lineage), never from caller-filled fields; approval binding must be signed by the Authority.
Generic execution IPC is disabled and must remain disabled. CP7 approval must not incidentally open executePlan to the WebView.

surfaces.approval_check: not applicable: local API credential rotation, not plan approval
surfaces.note: Local API token management is orthogonal to execution approval and grants no execution authority. Tracked for completeness only.

surfaces.replay_check: memory-only; empty after restart (restart replay is possible today by design of CP3)
surfaces.note: CP7 must introduce the durable approval store/ledger with crash-safe writes. Corrupt ledger must fail closed, never silently reset to empty.
